conditional_critical.q0: The Phase 7 contact count would give a second exact area lower bound once an exact integer n_q0 is certified; this phase does not manufacture that missing bound.
conditional_critical.statement: If H_q<=C q^mu effectively for all large q, then A(w)>=(log_2(3)/mu+o(1))q/log_2(q).

conditional_cycle.dependencies: P145 plus the exact cycle product bound; no such polynomial minimum theorem is accepted here.
conditional_cycle.statement: An effective m<=C q^mu for all large coprime positive cycles implies A=Omega(q^(2/3)).

critical_area.factor_proof: The infinite mechanical prefix has at most n+1 factors; changing its final 1 to the finite critical word's final 0 adds at most one terminal factor. Each internal adjacent swap adds factors at at most n+1 starts.
critical_area.sharp_proposal_refuted: NG32: q=4, c_q=1101100, n=2, A=0 has four factors {00,01,10,11}, exceeding n+1=3.
critical_area.swap_orientation: The critical word is obtained from c_q by A swaps 01->10.

critical_repetition.height: At a contact start t, x_t<3N+q; under P54, x_t<3H_q+q.

cycle_area.identity: For a valid coprime residue profile a, sum a_r is the literal expanded-word adjacent-swap distance from the profile-zero Christoffel representative.
cycle_area.triangular: A>=h(h+1)/2 because the time-ordered profile can decrease by at most one at a wrap transition.

cycle_separation.height: For a primitive positive integer cycle, M<2^(h+2)m/lambda.
cycle_separation.scope: Primitive positive integer cycle with gcd(L,q)=1; not a negative cycle or rational noninteger shadow.

literature_boundary: Mechanical/Christoffel terminology is contextual. All accepted Phase 23 identities are derived in the repository; no new external theorem is promoted. EXT15 and EXT16 retain their Phase 22 scopes only.
